We have an exciting opportunity for an IT Operations Engineer to join our National Operations Centre (NOC) team. We are seeking candidates with a strong background in IT systems and networks, coupled with extensive experience in managing IT service desk operations, and providing high-level support to internal and external staff. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in collaborating with various IT teams, ensuring the delivery of high-quality services to the business, while striving for operational excellence.

Please note this will be a permanent, full-time role based out of our Sydney CBD Office. It will involve participation in a continuous shift roster - working 4 days on and 4 days off. The shift patterns will be made up of 2-day shifts from 7am-7pm and 2-night shifts from 7pm-7am. 

Some of your responsibilities will include and are not limited to
•	Monitoring critical business services and systems, networks and infrastructure
•	Provide after-hours service desk support to users
•	Identify and address issues before they affect business operations
•	Handle and administer privileged accounts securely

What you’ll have done
•	Seasoned service desk analyst, NOC or equivalent experience (minimum 2 years), ideally in a continuous shift operations centre (24/7x365)
•	Strong technical knowledge of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, and other networking protocols
•	Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues quickly, including experience with major incidents
•	Familiarity with server operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and basic server administration
•	Experience with technology service monitoring tools - systems, application, and networks such as Centreon, Solarwinds, PTRG desirable
•	Familiarity with IT service management tools and frameworks (ITIL v3/4)
•	Demonstrated experience in delivering exemplary support, customer service and training
•	Excellent documentation skills for keeping records of issues, resolutions, and operational procedures
•	Effective communication with the ability to work as part of a team, especially in a high-pressure environment where collaboration is essential to solving issues

What we can offer you
•	5 weeks annual leave 
•	Annual salary between 90,000 - 95,000
•	Opportunities to progress within I-MED’s continued growth and expansion 
•	Being part of a team that makes a difference to the functioning of our ever-growing business 
•	Experience in communicating with different areas of IT 
•	Enjoy exclusive benefits including discounted private health insurance, salary packaging, Fitness Passport access, lifestyle and travel discounts, I-MED services for your family and employee wellbeing support.

About Us
At I-MED, we're more than just a medical imaging provider - we're a community of passionate professionals committed to excellence for our patients. With over 200 clinics and a staggering 6 million patient procedures annually, we proudly stand as one of the largest providers of medical imaging in the world. Our success lies in our people with over 350 dedicated doctors and 4,000 staff members who actively share clinical knowledge and expertise. 

If you're looking for the next step in your career and are passionate about the delivery of excellence within healthcare services, apply today!

We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role
The ICT Support Engineer develops support procedures and strategies for systems, networks, operating systems and applications development. This role provides technical expertise and direction in support of system infrastructure and process improvements, diagnoses and resolves complex system problems, and ensures the delivery of high-quality 24/7 technical support services. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems related to hardware, software, networks, and systems infrastructure, including installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade, and configuration of desktops, servers, email, databases, operating systems, and security systems.
•	Develop and implement support procedures and strategies for systems, networks, operating systems, and applications development, defining escalation, response, and resolution timeframes based on criticality and impact.
•	Prioritise and triage incoming incidents and service requests to ensure timely response and appropriate escalation, managing Incident and Change queues to ensure service restoration and completion within agreed SLAs.
•	Act as the primary escalation point of contact for onshore and offshore teams, managing High Impact Incidents across affected lines of business and driving restoration within agreed timeframes.
•	Test, identify, and diagnose functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines, and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification.

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the organisation's IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of our server environments, networks, and supporting systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage both day-to-day operations and longer-term infrastructure planning.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, software, and associated infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve server-related hardware and software malfunctions across workstations, servers, and communication infrastructure, providing timely service support to minimise disruption
- Monitor network performance and system health on an ongoing basis, identifying potential issues and making proactive adjustments to maintain service quality and reliability
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including operational procedures, system logs, configuration records, and IT policies and instructions
- Assess current and future infrastructure needs by regularly surveying existing systems and recommending enhancements to server capacity, network design, and technology implementation
- Ensure computer site design and layout allows all hardware and software components to integrate and function cohesively within the broader IT environment
- Manage system security measures including user access controls, patch management, antivirus solutions, and firewall configurations to protect organisational data and assets
- Plan, implement, and test backup and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard data integrity and ensure business continuity
- Administer and support databases, virtualisation platforms, and cloud-based services as required by the organisation
- Collaborate with IT team members, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve escalated technical issues
- Provide guidance and technical support to end users and junior IT staff, promoting best practices and ensuring effective use of systems and tools
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proven experience in a Systems Administrator or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
- Demonstrated experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall management
- Proficiency in virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions and the ability to develop and test recovery procedures
- Sound understanding of IT security principles, including access management, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and maintain accurate system records
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and work both autonomously and as part of a collaborative team
## Preferred Qualifications
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate or equivalent cloud certification
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
- Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python for task automation
- ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within an ITIL-aligned service management framework
- Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 administration
- Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Nagios, PRTG, or SolarWinds
- Prior experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative IT team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the organisation
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance, including hybrid working arrangements where applicable
- Contribute to meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the organisation's operations and strategic direction
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits, in an organisation that recognises and rewards performance
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
